scope: Research and recording only, before implementation/support claims

profiles.nativeVersion: Linux GPIO character-device API v2; exact future kernel/build enrollment required
profiles.selector: one enrolled stable chip identity and line offset
profiles.typedOutput: logical edge enum and bounded numeric sequence; native nanosecond clock provenance
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: native-event fixtures and original authority/lifecycle deadlines
profiles.equipment: Linux board, safely wired input and named kernel/driver
profiles.failure: denied, busy, unsupported API, source loss/sequence gap, cancelled, uncertain native release

profiles.nativeVersion: TMP102 driver/hwmon ABI; TI SBOS397I June 2024 wire reference
profiles.selector: one already provisioned TMP102 parent I2C path/address and hwmon identity
profiles.typedOutput: signed integer millidegrees Celsius; explicit exact Cel conversion with provenance
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: actual ABI text fixtures including read-not-ready/error and signed exact conversion
profiles.equipment: TMP102 board, reference thermometer, wiring/address and native driver
profiles.failure: missing, denied, source error, startup unavailable, malformed, stale/unknown conversion age

profiles.nativeVersion: Linux mcp320x IIO direct-mode MCP3008; Microchip DS20001295E 2022
profiles.selector: one already provisioned SPI controller/chip select and single-ended channel0
profiles.typedOutput: integer0..1023 unit1 with nominal reference provenance
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: producer ABI integer fixtures, errors and changed identity
profiles.equipment: MCP3008 board and safe reference/input source
profiles.failure: unsupported/missing driver, denied, native read failure, invalid code, uncertain device presence

profiles.nativeVersion: pcsc-lite API docs2.4.1; installed build and reader driver enrollment required
profiles.operation: bounded SCardGetStatusChange only; exact context cancellation/release
profiles.typedOutput: presence boolean plus explicit native state bitmask/diagnostic; no UID/authentication
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: state-bitmask/return-code fixtures and cancelled/timeout reader wait
profiles.equipment: named reader/firmware/driver and approved test cards
profiles.failure: no service, unknown/unavailable reader, mute, cancelled, timeout, denied, native release uncertainty

profiles.nativeVersion: Osmocom librtlsdr exact artifact/version to be pinned before implementation
profiles.selector: one receiver serial/USB identity, explicit frequency/rate/gain settings
profiles.operation: finite receive capture; no TX, bias tee, detach, direct sampling or remote service
profiles.typedOutput: bounded interleaved unsigned-byte I/Q resource; raw capture only
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: native byte fixture, quotas, callback after cancel and actual native join
profiles.equipment: named dongle/tuner and owner-approved test reception/signal source
profiles.failure: unsupported tuner/settings, denied, short/lost capture, overload, cancelled, uncertain native release; protocol decode unsupported

profiles.nativeVersion: Linux CEC userspace ioctl ABI; exact kernel/adapter required
profiles.operation: NO_INITIATOR|MONITOR then receive; CAP_NET_ADMIN must already be granted
profiles.typedOutput: bounded native frame bytes, rx status and timestamp; no inferred TV state
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: message/status fixtures, wrong length, timeout and disconnection/release
profiles.equipment: CEC-capable adapter and approved source/display topology
profiles.failure: denied capability, unsupported mode, busy, receive timeout, unplug, malformed frame

profiles.nativeVersion: ANSI/ASHRAE135-2024 reference plus selected target Protocol_Revision/PICS; actual implementation artifact pending
profiles.selector: one BACnet/IPv4 unicast peer/port+Device instance+AnalogInput instance
profiles.typedOutput: REAL plus units enum/native flags; non-atomic tuple; fault/out-of-service suppression
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: pinned local maintainer producer wire with ACK/errors/mismatch/timeout fixtures
profiles.equipment: named controller firmware/PICS and safely observed AnalogInput with physical reference
profiles.failure: denied, no reply, Error/Abort/Reject, wrong peer/invoke/object/type, unknown units, partial/quality-invalid tuple

profiles.nativeVersion: ChirpStack v4 integration UplinkEvent/Protobuf JSON; selected LoRaWAN1.0.4 ClassA device region
profiles.selector: one enrolled broker, applicationId/devEui exact up topic and device session provenance
profiles.typedOutput: opaque payload bytes/counters, server UTC/radio metadata provenance; no decoder units or MIC proof
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: official producer JSON/proto/defaults and owned broker lifecycle/replay caller
profiles.failure: denied ACL, incompatible producer settings, wrong identity/topic, malformed data, stale/retained/duplicate message, session change/source loss

profiles.nativeVersion: same MCP3008/IIO direct-read implementation; no buffered waveform profile
profiles.selector: same SPI enrolled path, channel0 and nominal reference; calibration revision if subsequently provided
profiles.typedOutput: code0..1023 unit1, nominal scale provenance, unknown source capture time; volts only with reviewed calibration/conversion
profiles.firstSoftwareCheck: raw/scale/calibration-unavailable fixtures and irregular/late poll handling
profiles.equipment: ADC board, measured reference and safe calibrated input; saturation/timing/reference-drift evidence
profiles.failure: calibration unavailable, invalid/error code, nominal reference changed, stale/lost source, uncertain capture time

preImplementationGates: review exact A01 profile manifest and bounded public caller
freeze exact native binaries/OS/kernel/firmware and actual producer output
resource owner plus native OS/driver/broker authority
choose native dependency distribution and file-level license policy
RF application decoder if wanted is separately selected
ChirpStack actual QoS/retained/contentType/session behavior must be frozen
Q03 fixtures, Q02 installed public caller, Q08 physical device qualification

validation.review: JSON parses; nine unique research IDs; every source ID resolves; family coverage seven. Proposed software limits are planning budgets, not measured physical/performance evidence.

retainedEvidence.policy: Exact scratch sources, rejected regressions, controlled mutation copies, actual installed artifacts and research metadata retained locally. Executed source/compiler/runtime/dependency closure hashes remain in exact installed proof; unchanged SDK release artifacts retain prior qualification.

requiredCandidateGates.policy: Only exact frozen candidate result proves these broad gates; fresh build before rendered checks; no red commit.

acceptance.futureGate: Every actual connector needs its own exact native/profile/caller/permission/license/equipment qualification. These proposed profiles are not SDK manifests.
